configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the server name visible in the game browser

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for admin access to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Message Of The Day
configurationFields.description: Sets the player welcome message (MOTD). Format is "Line1","Line2"

configurationFields.label: MOTD Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval between between display of each line of the MOTD

configurationFields.label: Enable Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the server whitelist. Enter Player IDs under "Whitelisted Players"

configurationFields.label: Whitelisted Players
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of whitelisted Player IDs (44 characters long ID), which can be found in the admin log file (.ADM). Comments can be added after two forward slashes. Example: 1111111111112222222222222333333333XXXXXXAAAA //Bilbo Baggins

configurationFields.label: Banned Players
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of banned Player IDs, in the same format as Whitelisted Players. These bans are separate to BattlEye bans

configurationFields.label: Instance ID
configurationFields.description: Sets the DayZ server instance ID, to identify the number of instances per box and their storage folders with persistence files

configurationFields.label: Server Mission
configurationFields.description: Sets the mission to load on server startup. If Custom is selected, the "Custom Mission Name" must also be specified

configurationFields.label: Custom Mission Name
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom mission to load on startup. Format is <MissionName>.<TerrainName>. The Custom mission type must be selected under "Server Mission"

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Login Queue Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that can wait in the server login queue

configurationFields.label: Login Queue Concurrent Players
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of players concurrently processed during the login process, to prevent a performance drop when many people are connecting at the same time

configurationFields.label: Load Mods
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of [mod directories]() to load (not server-side only mods). ONE LINE ONLY! Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths

configurationFields.label: Load Server Mods
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of [server-side only mod directories]() to load (the mods are not broadcast to clients). ONE LINE ONLY! Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths

configurationFields.label: Client Mods
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of [client-side only mod directories](). ONE LINE ONLY! These won't be loaded by the server, but will be used by the Manage Bikeys setting if enabled. Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths

configurationFields.label: Manage Bikeys
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the bikey files for each of the mods specified in Load Mods and Client Mods will be copied to the 'keys' directory on server start, to enable addon signature verification. All existing bikeys in that directory (other than the default 'dayz.bikey') will be deleted

configurationFields.label: Server/RCON IP Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the binding of the server and BattlEye RCON by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance. NOTE: The IP must be reachable by GSCS, otherwise GSCS's console won't work

configurationFields.label: Enable Server File Patching
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows loading of unpacked data

configurationFields.label: Allow Client File Patching
configurationFields.description: If enabled, clients with the "-filePatching" launch parameter enabled will be able to connect

configurationFields.label: Force Same Build
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will allow connections only by clients with same the build version as the server

configurationFields.label: Enable FPS Limit
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server FPS will be limited to the value set under "FPS Limit Value". Disabling this setting can have a severe effect on server performance

configurationFields.label: FPS Limit Value
configurationFields.description: Sets the limit for the server FPS, to lower CPU usage of low population servers. Requires "Enable FPS Limit" to be set

configurationFields.label: FPS Warning Trigger Value
configurationFields.description: Sets the server FPS value under which the initial server FPS warning will be triggered

configurationFields.label: Maximum Ping
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum ping value for clients, above which the clients will be kicked

configurationFields.label: Ping Initial Warning Trigger Value
configurationFields.description: Sets the ping value that will trigger the initial yellow ping warning for clients

configurationFields.label: Ping Critical Warning Trigger Value
configurationFields.description: Sets the ping value that will trigger the critical red ping warning for clients

configurationFields.label: Enable RPT File Logging
configurationFields.description: If set, enables all log messages in the server RPT file. Generally preferable to keep enabled, however some mods will stop the server from starting if this is set

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Startup Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional startup parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional settings to include in "serverDZ.cfg" that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line

configurationFields.label: Disable Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, players will not be able to use in-game voice chat

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Quality
configurationFields.description: Sets the voice chat codec quality, the higher the better

configurationFields.label: Disable Third Person View
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the third person view for players

configurationFields.label: Disable Crosshair
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the crosshair for players

configurationFields.label: Disable Personal Light
configurationFields.description: If set, disables personal light for all clients connected to the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Darker Nights
configurationFields.description: Use 1 for darker nights on vanilla maps. Modded maps maybe use different values

configurationFields.label: Disable Base Damage
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the damage or destruction of fences and watchtowers

configurationFields.label: Disable Container Damage
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the damage or destruction of tents, barrels, wooden crates and seachests

configurationFields.label: Enable Debug Monitor
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server shows information about the character using a debug window in the corner of the screen

configurationFields.label: Disable Respawn Dialog
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the respawn dialog (new characters will randomly spawn)

configurationFields.label: Respawn Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the respawn delay before a player is able to get a new character on the server, when the previous one is dead

configurationFields.label: Server Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the initial in-game time of the server. "SystemTime" means the local time of the machine. Or set the time to some value in "YYYY/MM/DD/HH/MM" format, e.g "2015/4/8/17/23"

configurationFields.label: Server Time Acceleration
configurationFields.description: Sets a multiplier (0.1-64) for server time acceleration or deceleration. For example, if set to 24, time would move 24 times faster than normal, and an entire day would pass in one hour

configurationFields.label: Server Night Time Acceleration
configurationFields.description: Sets a multiplier (0.1-64) for server night time acceleration or deceleration, which is combined with the "Server Time Acceleration" multiplier. For example, if set to 4 and Server Time Acceleration is set to 2, night time would move 8 times faster than normal

configurationFields.label: Persistent Server Time
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the actual server time is saved to storage, so the next server start will use the saved time value

configurationFields.label: Maximum Terrain Render Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum terrain render distance on the server (if higher than "viewDistance=" in a client profile, the client side parameter applies)

configurationFields.label: Maximum Object Render Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum object render distance on the server (if higher than "preferredObjectViewDistance=" in a client profile, the client side parameter applies)

configurationFields.label: Enable Gameplay Settings File
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the use of cfggameplay.json to modify [gameplay settings](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/DayZ:Gameplay_Settings)

configurationFields.label: Storage Auto Fix
configurationFields.description: If enabled, checks if the persistence files are corrupted and replaces corrupted ones with empty ones

configurationFields.label: Player Simulation Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the limit on how much players can be simulated per frame (for server performance gains)

configurationFields.label: Enable Multi-Threaded Replication
configurationFields.description: If set, enables multi-threaded processing of the server's replication system. The number of worker threads is derived by the "maxcores" and "reservedcores" parameters for jobsystem in dayzsettings.xml

configurationFields.label: Enable Speed Hack Detection
configurationFields.description: If set, enables speed hack detection. Set the level of detection under "Speed Hack Detection Level"

configurationFields.label: Speed Hack Detection Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the speed back detection level. 1 = strict, 10 = benevolent. "Speed Hack Detection" must be enabled for this to take effect

configurationFields.label: Close Object Spawn Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the network bubble distance for spawn of close objects with items in them (such as backpacks)

configurationFields.label: Near Object Spawn Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the network bubble distance for spawn (despawn +10%) of near inventory item objects

configurationFields.label: Far Object Spawn Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the network bubble distance for spawn (despawn +10%) of far objects (other than inventory items)

configurationFields.label: Effects Spawn Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the network bubble distance for spawn of effects (curently only sound effects)

configurationFields.label: Log Time Stamp Format
configurationFields.description: Sets the format of the time stamps used in the .RPT log file

configurationFields.label: Log Server FPS
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval at which the server logs the average server FPS. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Log Server Memory
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval at which the server logs the server memory usage. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Log Player Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval at which the server logs the count of currently connected players. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Log Player Hits Only
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server logs player hits only, instead of all hits, in the admin log

configurationFields.label: Log Placement Actions
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server logs placement actions such as traps and tents, in the admin log

configurationFields.label: Log Basebuilding Actions
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server logs basebuilding actions (build, dismantle, destroy), in the admin log

configurationFields.label: Log Player Position List
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server logs the position of players every 5 minutes, in the admin log

configurationFields.label: Steam Query Packet Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum Steam query packet size. Required for mods on DayZ v1.26+

configurationFields.label: Enable Named Mod Directory Links
configurationFields.description: If set, mods downloaded under "Steam workshop items" will be linked to the server base directory in the format @modname, rather than just by reference to the mod ID. NOTE: Update the server after changing this setting

deploymentSteps.name: Modscript Download
deploymentSteps.source:
#!/bin/bash

ModDirFormat="$1"

cd ./dayz/1042420

workshopDir="./steamapps/workshop/content/221100"

if [ -d "$workshopDir" ]; then
  echo "Converting and linking mods"

  # Convert uppercase filenames to lowercase
  find "$workshopDir/" -depth -name "*[A-Z]*" -print0 | \
    xargs -0 -I {} bash -c "mv \"{}\" \"\$(echo \"{}\" | sed 's,\(.*\)\/\(.*\),\1\/\L\2,')\"" >/dev/null 2>&1

  find "$workshopDir" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d | while read -r modDir; do
    modName=""

    # Extract modName from meta.cpp
    metaCppPath="$modDir/meta.cpp"
    if [ -f "$metaCppPath" ]; then
      modName=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\([^"]\+\)".*/\1/p' "$metaCppPath")
    fi

    if [ -z "$modName" ]; then
      # Fallback: Try mod.cpp if meta.cpp does not contain a name
      modCppPath="$modDir/mod.cpp"
      if [ -f "$modCppPath" ]; then
        modName=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\([^"]\+\)".*/\1/p' "$modCppPath")
      fi

      if [ -z "$modName" ]; then
        # Final fallback: Try fetching name from Steam workshop webpage if no name found
        modID=$(basename "$modDir")
        modName=$(wget -qO- "https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=$modID" | \
          sed -n 's/.*<div class="workshopItemTitle">\([^<]*\)<\/div>.*/\1/p' | head -n 1)

        if [ -z "$modName" ]; then
          echo "Error: Unable to retrieve name for workshop item $modID. Skipping"
          continue
        fi
      fi
    fi

    # Sanitise modName
    modName=$(echo "$modName" | tr '/' '-' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')

    if [ "$ModDirFormat" = "false" ]; then
      # Remove @name symlinks
      rm -f "./@$modName" >/dev/null 2>&1

      # Create numbered symlinks
      ln -sf "$modDir" ./
    else
      # Remove numbered symlinks
      rm -f "./$(basename "$modDir")" >/dev/null 2>&1

      # Create @name symlink
      ln -sfT "$modDir" "./@$modName"
    fi
  done
else
  echo "No mods to convert and link"
fi

exit 0

deploymentSteps.name: Modscript Download
Manage Bikeys
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd dayz/1042420; find keys -name \"*.bikey\" ! -name \"dayz.bikey\" -delete; IFS=\";\" read -ra subdirs_array <<< \"{MOD};{CLIENTMOD}\"; for subdir in \"${subdirs_array[@]}\"; do [ -n \"$(shopt -s nullglob; echo $subdir/*.bikey)\" ] && \cp \"$subdir/\"*.bikey keys/ >/dev/null 2>&1; [ -d \"$subdir/keys\" ] && \cp \"$subdir/keys/\"*.bikey keys/ >/dev/null 2>&1; [ -d \"$subdir/key\" ] && \cp \"$subdir/key/\"*.bikey keys/ >/dev/null 2>&1; done"

deploymentSteps.name: Manage Bikeys
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$subdirs = \"{MOD};{CLIENTMOD}\" -split ';'; Set-Location dayz\1042420; Remove-Item '.\keys\*.bikey' -Exclude 'dayz.bikey' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($subdir in $subdirs) { Get-ChildItem -Path \"$subdir\*.bikey\" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Copy-Item $_ -Destination '.\keys' }; if (Test-Path \"$subdir\keys\") { Copy-Item \"$subdir\keys\*.bikey\" -Destination '.\keys' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path \"$subdir\key\") { Copy-Item \"$subdir\key\*.bikey\" -Destination '.\keys' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; }"
